description.value:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]] has the &Reference[Incapacitated] condition while in the area of an @UUID[Compendium.elkan5e.elkan5e-spells.Item.Ay9J4z6Zf9hl6d4w]{antimagic field}.

If targeted by @UUID[Compendium.elkan5e.elkan5e-spells.Item.oZwKW3I3yzrSdpLE]{dispel magic}, the [[lookup @name lowercase]] must succeed on a [[/save constitution]]{Constitution Save} against the caster's spell save DC or become &Reference[Unconscious] for 1 minute.
